welcome_text: Select Safaris Africa (“we,” “us,” “our”), operated by Peak Ventures LTD, is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable data protection laws. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, protect, and disclose information when you use our website, mobile application, or any of our travel services (“Service”). By accessing or using our Service, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy and agree to our Terms & Conditions.
personal_info_text:
Personal Information includes data that identifies you as an individual, such as:
- Full name
- Email address
- Phone number
- Postal address
- Nationality
- Passport or ID information
- Date of birth
- Travel preferences
- Medical conditions disclosed for trip suitability
- Payment information (processed securely via third-party providers)

We collect this information when you:
- Submit a booking
- Contact us
- Subscribe to newsletters
- Create an account
- Complete travel forms
non_personal_info_text:
This includes information that does not personally identify you:
- Browser type
- Device type
- IP address
- Pages visited
- Time spent on our site
- Cookies and analytical data

We use cookies and similar technologies for functionality, analytics, security, and user experience optimization.
usage_text:
We use your data to:
- Process and manage bookings
- Communicate with you about itineraries or payments
- Provide customer service
- Comply with legal obligations
- Improve our services and website
- Send marketing communications (optional; you may opt out)
- Prevent fraud and enhance security

We do not sell or rent your Personal Information to third parties.
third_party_text:
To fulfil your booking, we share necessary personal details with:
- Hotels and lodges
- Activity providers
- Transport operators
- Park authorities (for permits)
- Airlines
- Payment processors

These providers use your data only to deliver the contracted service.
legal_text:
We may disclose information if required to:
- Comply with law enforcement
- Respond to government requests
- Protect rights, safety, or property
business_text: If Select Safaris Africa or Peak Ventures LTD undergoes a merger or acquisition, user data may be transferred as part of the transaction.
children_text: Our services are not directed to individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If such data is identified, it will be deleted promptly.
security_text: We implement industry-standard administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your data. However, no method of electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute protection. You are responsible for safeguarding your account credentials.
international_text: Your data may be transferred to suppliers in countries outside your residence. By using our Service, you consent to these transfers, which are necessary for booking fulfillment.
rights_text:
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to:
- Access your personal data
- Update or correct inaccuracies
- Request deletion
- Withdraw marketing consent
- Request a copy of stored data

Requests can be sent to: info@selectsafarisafrica.com
cookies_text: You may choose to disable cookies in your browser. However, certain site features may not function properly without them.
changes_text: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Material changes will be announced via the website or email and take effect 30 days after notification.
